layout_note: Single-column centred title page inside a full-page woodcut ornamental border (repeating floral/knotwork strapwork; NO text set within the border, so no border_motto). Two horizontal rules divide the page: the upper rule separates the title/subtitle block from the Isaiah 12:3 scripture motto (Latin line 14 + English rendering line 15); the lower rule separates the motto from the imprint. Languages: English display + one Latin scripture line. Top display is roman capitals (no long-ſ possible); the descriptive subtitle mixes roman caps with italic lower-case. A hand-inked collation numeral '5' sits in the upper-right corner (not printed). The coat-of-arms device and 'www.fatimamovement.com' at lower-left are a modern digitisation watermark, NOT part of the 1609 page — ignored.

body.text: Diligently conferred with the Hebrew, Greeke,
and other Editions in diuers languages.
With ARGVMENTS of the Bookes, and Chapters:
for better vnderſtanding of the text : for diſcouerie of
CORRVPTIONS in ſome late tranſlations : and
BY THE ENGLISH COLLEGE OF DOWAY.
Haurietis aquas in gaudio de fontibus Saluatoris. Iſaiæ.12.
You shal draw waters in ioy out of the Sauiours fountaines.
Printed at Doway by LAVRENCE KELLAM,
at the ſigne of the holie Lambe.

uncertain.note: small italic scripture citation 'Iſaiæ' (Isaiæ, gen. of Isaias) with medial long-ſ and æ ligature, then '.12.'. Long-ſ vs round-s on the small italic 's' is medium confidence; the reference numeral reads '12'.

a small raised comma-like tick sits between the K and E of KELLAM (OCR scaffold renders it K‘ELLAM). Judged an ink speck / broken-type artifact, not a printed glyph, so transcribed as 'KELLAM'; flagged in case it is intentional pointing.

glyph_counts.note: 'shal' (line 15) is set with a ROUND s here, not long-ſ — verified by glyph. French-spacing (space before high punctuation) is present on 'text :' and 'tranſlations :' but NOT on 'Chapters:' / 'ANNOTATIONS:' / 'TABLES:', per the compositor. Counts are hand-observed; authoritative recount should come from a script.

method: visual-multimodal-read of 400 DPI raster (region crops magnified for long-ſ / u-v / French-spacing disambiguation); OCR scaffold used only as a dropped-line hint, never as a spelling oracle
confidence: high on the roman-capital title block (lines 0-5) and the italic descriptive subtitle (lines 6-13); high on the imprint English; medium on the small italic Latin scripture citation 'Iſaiæ.12.' and the stray tick in 'KELLAM'
